violations.text: The lowboy cooler was observed maintaining ambient temperature over 41 degrees Fahrenheit degrees. The unit is not to be used for any TCS foods. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026
The mop sink was observed in poor repair (not draining properly). Mop sink being repaired at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 150-400 ppm. Proper ware-washing procedures reviewed with person in charge at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2025

Eggs were observed held at 53 degrees Fahrenheit in a melted ice bath. Ice bath was changed and food moved to refrigeration to rapidly cool. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of pink residue. The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the contamination of ice. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2025
The ceiling in the cookline area has an accumulation of dust. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2025
